name: Thumbnail Expand
description: Editorial article page opening on a small centered thumbnail between two tilted side thumbnails. Clicking expands it to a full-width hero while the title reveals and the article body appears.
contents: Centered hero thumbnail with meta number and title label
Left and right side thumbnails with number and title
Article title, subtitle, three-cell body text with pull quote, parallax body image
Footer band with label and next label
behavior: Hovering the thumbnail zooms it and tilts the side thumbnails outward
Clicking expands the thumbnail to full width with a GSAP timeline and reveals title and subtitle
Body image moves with scroll parallax
Pull quote and next label reveal on entering the viewport
Custom circle cursor follows the mouse, grows over the thumbnail, hidden on touch devices

props.name: subtitle
props.default: What is wanted is not the will to believe, but the wish to find out, which is its exact opposite.

props.name: pullQuote
props.default: The Crown that the Deathless pray for

editableByProps: All text, images, side thumbnail content and footer labels
Background, text, footer and cursor colors
Thumbnail and expanded image sizes, article width and padding
Expand, text reveal, hover and parallax timing and strength

needsCodeEdit.change: Add more body paragraphs or cells
Change the body image aspect ratio

fixed: Adds a Google Fonts stylesheet link to document head when loadGoogleFonts is true; it is not removed on unmount
Full-screen cover overlay fades out once GSAP has loaded
Side thumbnails layer is fixed to the viewport while the intro is shown
Custom cursor is fixed to the viewport and hidden on coarse pointers
Window resize, mousemove and scroll listeners are removed on unmount
